title: Rename PBI embedded pages
summary: Embedded Power BI report pages in the Power BI Reports, Subscription Billing and Sustainability apps were renamed. The change covers 127 files, each with a small two-line edit.
key_points: Embedded Power BI pages were renamed across 127 files
Covers finance, inventory, manufacturing, projects, purchasing and sales pages in Power BI Reports
Also covers Power BI pages in Subscription Billing and Sustainability
Each file changes only two lines
